translation.name: YISU KILISI ANE BINGE VIE GIENGK IWAL AVOS

book.name: ROM
book.title: Pol ane kapia gitangi amolmol Rom ane

content: Tanalgum and nune-nggen as yaun ite
Ginei amol ti ane aplo givin gwangne ite, okob yem un-gas ei ninme nivang nivin yem. Bemem unei yaun walang ano nitangi ei bwaya.
Ve amol ti ei aplo givin gwangne molge, be ei gitangi ebe ve nen wenk be tis gen walang etenik ok. Bemem amol ti, ei aplo givin gwangne ite be ei gen wer ge.

Dangetok be mie ret ete gitangi ve non gen walang etok ok, mie nuli amol ete gen wer ge ok tiate ite. Be mi ret ete gon wer ge ok, mie nuli amol ete gen gen walang ok gitangi ge ok tiate bwaya. Ve Pomate gital ei ginei natu givin weik etok ge.

Mie amol ret beti ve nulgum amol bamo ti ane amolmol kulkul ane as yaun? Ginei ei nivarkei gwangne me nimbieg ok, bemem etok ei ane amol bamo ane kulkul be atob nilgum ane amolmol kulkul ane as yaun. Bingano. Amol Bamo gitangi atob niro ei ta be nivarkei gwangne.

Amol ti ei gili as mate ti vie molge gitlek as mate subu, be amol ti gili as mate walang ok gitangi ate-ngge. Amolmol walang ok ilgum gen gitangi ebe as tas gitung ok gitang-tangi ge. Amol ebe gili as mate ti vie molge gitlek subu ok, ei gilgum ve avo ges Amol Bamo are.

Be amol ebe gen wenk tis gen walang ok, ei ok gilgum ve avo ges Amol Bamo are be ginei ane ta-vie gitangi Pomate ve gen etok ane. Be amol ebe gen wer ge ok, ei giamar gen subu ve ta gitung Amol Bamo, be ei ok ginei ane ta-vie gitangi Pomate givin weik etok ge.
Dangetok be eitit tatpweng are gikwai ve amol ti gibweg matawe ve ei ate ane gwangne ane ite. Be amol ti gimat vunu ve ei ate ane gwangne ane ite.
Be ginei eitit tanambweg matawand, me tanmat vunu, etok Amol Bamo ge ane gen. Dangetok be ginei eitit tanambweg matawand me tanmat vunu, etok Kilisi ane amolmol-gen ete eitit nik.
Beti Kilisi gimat vunu be gimdil vukuri be gibweg weik amolmol ebe imat vunu ok be tis eisir ebe imbweg matawas ok as Amol Bamo.
Be mie amol ret beti gulgum am nune ane yaun? Be mie ret beti guli am nune tiate? Eitit tepwengge atob tanvarkei Pomate na be nilgum eitit and yaun.
Ve yaun ebe giengk Pomate ane kapia ok ginei dangeteik:

content.text: “Amol Bamo ginei. Bingano. Ayeu gabweg matawangg, be amolmol tepwengge atob inro vas dubi supwe nisov nalk nitangi ayeu.
Be amolmol tepwengge atob intal Ayeu inei Pomate ano.’

content: Be Pol ginei; Dangetok beti atob eitit tepwengge tanvarkei Pomate na be tanei and yaun nitangi Ei nitang-tangi ge.
Tanalgum and nune-nggen tiate ite
Dangetok be eitit tanalgum and nune-nggen as yaun bwaya. Undi velob unemb bunam nitangi eisir be invang tis bunam ge ok, velob Pomate nitin eisir.

Amol Bamo Yisu givang givin ayeu be gilgum be ayeu gatpweng gen walang etenik are gikwai ganei gen etok tepwengge ti tiate ite. Bemem ginei amol ti gili ginei gen walang etok subu tiate, okob etok gitangi ebe ei ate ane ta givin ok.

Dangetok be ginei mie non gen ti ebe am nune gili tiate ok, okob atob mie nutpweng are ve mie guvang mul ve luev tas givin is ate ane ite. Namnambed? Kilisi Ei gimat vunu ve miam nune-nggen ane givin weik etok ge, dangetok be mie nuyaing eisir ve am ben ete gon ok bwaya.
Unemb aim gen vevies dabin vie-ngge velob amolmol inei yaun ungglus-ungglus nipil aim gen vevies etok.
Ve Pomate geb amolmol dabin gisov gen ebe en be inum ok ite. Bemem gisov ebe es as luev vie-ngge be ivang tis tas vevie-ngge ok ane. Ve luev etok, etok Ngalau Yamar ane luev.
Amol ti ginei nilgum Kilisi ane kulkul be nes ane luev vie-ngge dangetok, atob Pomate nili ei weik amol vie ti be atob amolmol avos nivwat ei are.
Dangetok be eitit tanvang mul ve luev tas givin is ate ane, be tis luev ebe ve tanro and nune-nggen ta ok.

Mie nuyaing Pomate ane kulkul ve gen walang ete tan be tanum ok bwaya. Bingano. Gen walang etok vie ve tanen be tanum, bemem ginei mie gon gen ti ebe gilgum am nune tiate ok, okob mie non gen etok bwaya, mie nuli weik ebe gen tiate ti ok.
Ginei mie gon bwelk me gunum wain, me gulgum gen ti ebe gitangi ve nilgum am nune aplo tiate ok, okob vie ve mie nulgum gen dangetok vukuri bwaya.

Mie tam nitung am aplom givin ebe giengk mie ate ane ok, ve etok mie ate be tis Pomate ge aim gen. Amol ti ginei ta gitung ane luev ebe givang ok love gili vie, be ei ate ok ges ane luev vie-ngge, amol etok atob ta vevie-ngge.

Bemem amol ti ginei nen gen ti be aplo ailu ailu ve gen ete gen ok ane, atob Pomate nilgum amol etok ane yaun. Ve ei gilgum gen etok tis aplo givin ite. Ve gen walang ete amolmol aplos givin ite be ilgum ok, gen etok tiate.
